MEATBALL.title: Meatball
MEATBALL.description: At the start of the first 2 turns, draw 1 extra card and gain 1 extra [gold]Energy[/gold].
MEATBALL.flavor: A round, hearty meatball. You feel extra energetic for the first two turns.
BIG_POT_MEAT.title: Big Pot Meat
BIG_POT_MEAT.description: At the start of the first 3 turns, draw 1 extra card and gain 1 extra [gold]Energy[/gold].
BIG_POT_MEAT.flavor: A big pot of meat that keeps you going for the first three turns.
HAMBURGER.title: Hamburger
HAMBURGER.description: At the start of each combat, gain 3 [gold]Regen[/gold]. On the first turn, draw 1 extra card and gain 1 extra [gold]Energy[/gold].
HAMBURGER.flavor: A balanced stack of greens and meat. Fills you with confidence.
ROASTED_STONE.title: Roasted Stone
ROASTED_STONE.description: At the start of the first 3 turns of each combat, gain 7 [gold]Block[/gold].
ROASTED_STONE.flavor: It's made of stone and it's great at humidifying. Really helps during dry months.
FAILED_DISH.title: Failed Dish
FAILED_DISH.description: A failed dish. It does nothing.
FAILED_DISH.flavor: A burnt, unidentifiable mess. It does not look appetizing.
